{{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:AftermathIcon.png]] |-|Full Icon = [[File:AftermathBanner.png]] |chapter = TDS: Origins |previous_mission = [[Lights Out]] |next_mission = TBA }} ==Description== '''Aftermath''' is a cutscene for the first chapter of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. It happens after [[Lights Out]] concludes. ==Cutscene== [[File:Aftermath (Chapter 1- Cutscene 4)|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
The [[Trapper]], [[Commander]], [[Soldier]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Sniper]] fend off against the zombies while the Recruit is hiding behind some barricades. [[Professor V]] informs [[Commander]] that the turrets are now online, which leads to the Recruit running up to a red button with a skull on it. This causes a few turrets to pop up, with the one observed by us having a zombie get on top of it. These begin firing at the zombies in the area, clearing out large amounts of them. The zombie that was on the turret falls off it once it has stopped firing, then begins trying to run away. It is however interrupted as [[Professor V]] tested out her gun on it, which made her find out that the gun disintegrates things it is fired at. She then tries to find out if the agents are fine, though she first gets questions from [[Commander]] about finding someone which is interrupted by the [[Soldier]] who wants to find [[Demoman]] and [[Hops]]. While asking her if they are alive, the [[Demoman]] can be seen walking in the distance with his arm on his stomach. He explains what happened in mines, then brings out [[Hops]]' beret which he gives to the [[Soldier]]. He tells him that [[Hops]] got taken by the zombies. This is quickly shown to not be true when [[Hops]] comes out and slaps the [[Soldier]]'s shoulder. He at first slightly mad about the situation, though he gets over it and begins laughing. The cutscene then changes into a still shot with a brown tint, which is followed by it now showing everyone standing around or on the [[Grave Digger]]'s body. The camera later zooms in on the [[Soldier]] and [[Hops]], which later turns into a photo given to the [[Commander]] by the other agents, placed on his computer next to a note with a to do list. In this recruitment center, he is reading the records of the new recruit, which includes their criminal record. This recruit is then revealed to be the [[Scout]], ending the cutscene.
===Script===
'''Script'''
[[File:AftermathCutscene.ogg|300px]]
''[[T.D.S. Organization]] agents fight off zombies while the Recruit is hiding behind a barricade.'' {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Turrets online! {{Color|Commander}}: GET DOWN! ''The Recruit begins running to press a button with a skull on it.'' ''Various turrets open up all around the area and begin spraying bullets at the zombies.'' ''The zombie that was on top of the turret falls off it and begins to run away, just to be disintegrated by someone shortly after.'' {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Huh, so that's what it does. Neat! {{Color|ProfessorV}}: You guys alright? {{Color|Commander}}: We need to go back and find- {{Color|Soldier}}: Did anyone else come out of that mine?' {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Woah... What are you- {{Color|Soldier}}: Please, PLEASE tell me they made it. ''The [[Demoman]] can be seen walking in the back, showing signs of being injured.'' {{Color|Soldier}}: No... {{Color|Demoman}}: They... Flooded the tunnels. ''The [[Demoman]] pulls out [[Hops]]' beret.'' {{Color|Demoman}}: We barely made it through. {{Color|Demoman}}: The zombies grabbed him and dragged him back in. ''The [[Demoman]] gives the beret to [[Soldier]].'' {{Color|Demoman}}: I- I did everything I could. But it wasn't enough. {{Color|Demoman}}: I'm sorry. ''The camera moves to show all of the other agents all having varying reactions, some going as far as crying.'' ''[[Hops]] comes in and slaps the [[Soldier]] on his shoulder.'' {{Color|Hops}}: Ahh we're just messin' with ya'. Were you about to cry- ''The [[Soldier]] punches [[Hops]].'' {{Color|Demoman}}: Hey easy! His idea! {{Color|Soldier}}: I'm keeping this now. {{Color|Hops}}: You know I had to get you back! {{Color|Soldier}}: No! You suck, all of you! {{Color|Commander}}: Are you guys done? ''The screen becomes tinted.'' {{Color|Soldier}}: No, I think we're just getting started. ''Now shows a still image of everyone standing around or on the [[Grave Digger]]'s body''. ''Camera zooms in on the [[Soldier]] and [[Hops]], revealing that in specific is an image from the rest of the crew put next to a note with a to do list, which includes reviewing enemy [[logbooks]], a council call with new netrow, coordination with [[Cyber City|cyber city]] defense repairs and more.'' {{Color|Commander}}: Insubordination, retaliation. Arson, allegedly... {{Color|Commander}}: Assault on a superior, and a stack of paperwork banning you from every major city. {{Color|Commander}}: You've been tossed out of every defensive agency, and now you're here. {{Color|Commander}}: So, tell me now... ''The camera reveals that the new recruit is the [[Scout]].'' {{Color|Commander}}: Are we gonna have any problems?
